text: 中国1至7月新增人民币贷款 103800亿人民币，前值 107200亿人民币。 中国7月M2货币供应同比 7.7%，前值 8%。 中国7月M1货币供应同比 4%，前值 4%。 中国7月M0货币供应同比 11.6%，前值 11.8%。
text_en: China's new RMB loans for January to July were 10,380 billion yuan, compared with a previous value of 10,720 billion yuan. China's July M2 money supply grew 7.7% year on year, versus 8% previously. China's July M1 money supply grew 4% year on year, versus 4% previously. China's July M0 money supply grew 11.6% year on year, versus 11.8% previously.
